newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Tuesday.

They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also lower, as weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan pressured the market. The market also failed to gain on the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar and an earlier fall in Japan's rubber stocks.
"The (Japanese) market's failure to react to bullish factors suggests that speculative interest in rubber fututes is thin," one broker said.

"(Local) prices were quiet and featureless in the morning but were marked down in the afternoon as some selling interest emerged in sympathy with lower prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 fell 1.25 cents to 118.50 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 fell 1.25 cents to 173.00 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg.
March TSR20 fell one cent to 165.00 Singapore cents (U$S1.18) a kg.
